## MKCinema 1.2: smoother TV, easier remote, voice search

| Platform | File | Requirements |
|---|---|---|
| Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV | `MKCinema-TV.apk` | Android TV 7 or later |
| Android phones and tablets | `MKCinema.apk` (the same file) | Android 7 or later |
| LG webOS (beta) | `com.mkcinema.app_1.1.0_all.ipk` | unchanged, Developer Mode or Homebrew Channel |
| Windows, macOS, Linux | unchanged from 1.0 | |

1.2 installs over 1.1 and keeps your sign-in.

### On a TV
- **Easier to follow:** a bold platinum ring and a small lift show what the remote has selected. You start on Smart Play, each row remembers where you were, and closing a title or the player puts you back on the poster you came from.
- **Smooth at High:** TVs use solid panels and skip ambilight and looping effects, so High runs smoothly and the app no longer drops a TV to Low.
- **Voice search:** the mic in search and the remote's search key now use your TV's speech recognizer. Some TVs, Fire TV in particular, may not offer one to apps; then the on-screen keyboard opens instead.
- **Player:** Up/Down reach the controls, Left/Right seek, OK plays or pauses, and Back leaves the controls before it leaves the player.

**Fire TV:** in Downloader, enter `mkctv.pages.dev`.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/itbelikethatbruh/MKCinema/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
